description: Replo's skills: how Replo's tools fit together, how to build and publish pages, and how to use each integration. Before doing Replo work, call skills to list every skill (each one's name and description), then skills with name to load one skill's full SKILL.md. A skill lists the files it bundles by relative path, such as references/fonts.md; read one by its skill directory and path, such as building-replo-pages/references/fonts.md. Works without a Replo account: call it before asking the user to sign in.

name.description: The one skill to load, by the name this tool lists (`klaviyo`), or a file a skill bundles, as its directory and relative path (`building-replo-pages/references/fonts.md`). Leave it out to list every skill.

name: skills
title: Read Replo skills
